root_causes.finding: Capacity summed allocatable resources from three NoSchedule control-plane nodes and therefore overstated participant pod capacity.
Five simultaneous heavy-seat rollouts were packed onto rhgnr1 until its 250-pod limit, coinciding with probe failures, restarts, and a node/network outage.
The pod validator failed successful completed Jobs and allowed Running-but-unready pods as warnings.
NFS reclaim could not traverse restrictive Showroom cache and PostgreSQL data directories after the node interruption.

red_green_matrix.red: NoSchedule and NotReady nodes contributed to workshop capacity.
red_green_matrix.green_local: Capacity and fleet-health calculations include only Ready, schedulable, untainted nodes and demand assigned to those nodes.

red_green_matrix.red: Succeeded bootstrap Jobs failed validation and Running unready pods did not fail it.
red_green_matrix.green_local: Succeeded pods pass; Running unready pods fail transiently and retry through a configurable live window.

red_green_matrix.red: Five simultaneous seats exhausted one worker's pod slots.
red_green_matrix.green_local: AgentOps declares 17 peak pods per seat and a workload-specific provisioning concurrency of four.

red_green_matrix.red: Five Released NFS volumes required ownership-aware permission normalization and cleanup exceeded ten minutes.
red_green_matrix.green_local: AgentOps Showroom home storage is ephemeral and PostgreSQL continuously normalizes persistent directory permissions.

release_decision.next_action: Deploy remediations and repeat the controlled five-seat Arena certification.
